# Provider logos

Brand SVG assets are from LobeHub Icons, licensed under the included
`LICENSE.lobe-icons.txt` (MIT, Copyright 2023 LobeHub).

OpenAI, SiliconFlow and ModelScope marks were added from
`@lobehub/icons-static-svg` version `1.102.0`:
https://www.npmjs.com/package/@lobehub/icons-static-svg

Upstream icon names: `openai.svg`, `siliconcloud.svg`, `modelscope.svg`.
The SiliconCloud asset is saved as `siliconflow.svg` to match the application's
existing provider ID. Other existing local marks are retained.
